role: prospectively specified seasonal-heat discrimination after long-term BIO5 association was opened
interpretation_boundary: The prespecified full gate failed because the same-cell local p-value was 0.054995, above 0.05.
Species-level and species-stratified tests strongly favored hotter flowering months for white observations.
The local same-cell estimate was in the predicted direction but cannot be promoted to support by changing the threshold or cell definition.
A species-disjoint cohort is required for a fresh confirmation.
hard_nonclaims: WorldClim monthly values are climatology, not weather in the observation year
does not establish temperature-induced plastic colour change
does not establish selection on pigment chemistry
does not establish pigmented-to-white evolutionary direction
